prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.406 °C/min (2% above healthy); TS2 mean temperature 41.9 °C (within 1% of healthy). Thermal characteristics align with nominal continuous cooling performance.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.93 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.56 s (3% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.41 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 399 W·min/l (4% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 55.7 % (5% below healthy). Significant reduction in delivered volume flow at nominal electrical power indicates severe internal pump slippage.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.3 bar (within 1% of healthy). Elevated pressure ripple across working lines indicates moderate degradation of accumulator pre-charge.
